go-version-input.description: Version of Go to use for govulncheck

check-latest.description: Set this option to true if you want the action to always check for the latest available Go version that satisfies the version spec

cache.description: Used to specify whether Go caching is needed. Set to true, if you would like to enable caching.

go-package.description: Go Package to scan with govulncheck

work-dir.description: Directory in which to run govulncheck

go-version-file.description: Path to the go.mod or go.work file.

output-file.description: The file to which the govulncheck output is saved
